title: Finite subfamilies of specified generators near a point
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V and K opens with K contained in V. Let H be an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that its restriction to K is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Let sigma be a specified generating family of H on V, namely an epimorphism from the free sheaf on sigma.I, and let x be a point of K. There exist an open neighbourhood U of x contained in K and a finite subset S of sigma.I such that the free map on S followed by sigma becomes an epimorphism after restriction from V to U. There is no compactness, affineness or quasi-coherence assumption.

proof.text: Apply the finite free local lift theorem to the specified generating epimorphism sigma.pi. Obtain U contained in K and a map l from a finite free module sheaf to the restricted source free sheaf with epimorphic composite.
Apply the finite free local support theorem to l at x. On a smaller neighbourhood W obtain a finite subset S of sigma.I and a factoring map a into the restriction of free S.

Restrict the epimorphic composite involving l from U to W. It stays epi because open restriction is a left adjoint and preserves cokernels. The factoring equality and functoriality identify this composite with a followed by the restriction of freeMap(S -> sigma.I) composed with sigma.pi. A right factor of an epimorphic composite is epi, giving the required map on W. Iterated overMap restrictions agree on sections and morphisms, and W is contained in K by transitivity.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01B8 and 01BB, finite-generator lifting and finite-support selection. The categorical composition, restriction, and epi factor argument are proved in Lean.

from.place: The finite-generation step of the affine-union construction in the H1 constructible representation: choose a finite support locally near each point before compactness selects a finite subcover.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finset_generatingSections_near_point
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V K : X.Opens) (hKV : K ≤ V)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [(H.over K).IsFiniteType] (σ : (H.over V).GeneratingSections) (x : K) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hUK : U ≤ K), (x : X) ∈ U ∧ ∃ S : Finset σ.I,
      Epi ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (hUK.trans hKV))).map
          (SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)
            ((↑) : S → σ.I) ≫ σ.π))
